|lore=Front: The Millennium Falcon's well-known reputation is favorable not only for its captain and first mate, but for the Alliance as well.''<br />''Back: Han's “special modifications” for Millennium Falcon included security mechanisms, deflector shields, hull plating, faster hyperdrive and enhanced weapons. |hatnote=Double-sided card (flips): the infobox and first image show the front (starship) side; the back (combat vehicle) side is shown second. Both sides' statistics, lore, and game text are listed below. Other versions of this Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card: [[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (ALT) (Errata)]], [[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (ALT) (Errata 2)]]. For the regular card, see [[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (Errata 5)]].
|game_text='''Front side — [[Starship]] ([[Starfighter]]), Heavily-Modified Light Freighter'''

Destiny 0 · Power 3 · Deploy 0 · Forfeit 7 · Maneuver 4 · Hyperspeed 6<br />Icons: [[Nav Computer]] [[Resistance]] [[Scomp Link]] [[Episode VII]]

May not be placed in Reserve Deck. If Falcon about to leave table, place it out of play. May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Has ship-docking capability. While [Episode VII] Han or Rey piloting, maneuver +2 and immune to attrition &lt; 4 (&lt; 6 if both). Once during your move phase, if at a site, may flip this card (even if unpiloted).

'''Back side — [[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle|Combat]]), Heavily-Modified Light Freighter'''

Destiny 7 · Power 3 · Deploy 0 · Forfeit 7 · Maneuver 5 · Landspeed 2<br />Icons: [[Resistance]] [[Scomp Link]] [[Episode VII]]

May not be placed in Reserve Deck. If Falcon about to leave table, place it out of play. May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Immune to Trample and Unsalvageable, even if unpiloted. While Finn or Rey aboard, immune to attrition &lt; 4 (&lt; 6 if both). Once during your move phase, if piloted, may flip this card.

|rulings=* If [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] is about to be lost, it is not possible to send it to a docking bay with [[I'll Take The Leader]]. [[The Falcon]] would go out of play first.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=The%20Falcon%2C%20Junkyard%20Garbage%20/%20%E2%80%A2The%20Falcon%2C%20Junkyard%20Garbage%20%28AI%29 Scomp: The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (AI)]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* When [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] flips to the vehicle side, any starship weapons are lost (even [[Concussion Missiles]], which deploys on a freighter).
* When [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] flips to the vehicle side, any Devices or Effects (of any kind) which use a clause of their deployment text to deploy on and/or target the [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] as a starship, are lost unless that same deployment clause can also target vehicles. Do not recheck any other deployment conditions.
* Similar logic to the above two rulings applies when flipping [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] to the starship side (i.e. lose vehicle weapons, lose any Devices or Effects of any kind unless the deployment clause can also target a starship).
* Flipping from starship to vehicle causes attached Mynocks to detach.

|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card (the AI images were renamed ALT by the PC; Bill, 12 Nov 2026). It is not the current version; the current version is [[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The images are the Players Committee card images of both sides of this version ([[:File:V4-L-thefalconjunkyardgarbagefront_ai-2022-01-07.gif]], [[:File:V4-L-thefalconjunkyardgarbageback_ai-2022-01-07.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing; card-image dates are the upload dates of the card-size image (<code>large</code> folder) in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026); pixel-identical re-uploads are not. '''Errata mark (combat vehicle (back) side):''' the first image of this Alternate Image card already prints “E” (it follows the errata count of the card's text); recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card images of both sides uploaded 7 January 2022<ref name="img-204_35a-0">Players Committee card images <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/thefalconjunkyardgarbagefront_ai.gif</code> and <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/thefalconjunkyardgarbageback_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8ba25cdb109b5da73d1397712bcc202e4a11ee69 commit 8ba25cd] (7 January 2022); the high-resolution copies (<code>hires/…_ai.png</code>, same pictures) were uploaded the day before, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/26f4c95070e8e65cf67c23e464b3a1b476792715 commit 26f4c95] (6 January 2022). Both files were uploaded again on 5 July 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe commit a41bae9] (fixing sizes)), pixel-identical, so that upload is not a version. The commit date is the upload date; the PC serves the latest version of each file at res.starwarsccg.org/cards/.</ref>. Document: starship (front) side: no errata mark, label “(AI)”, bottom margin “Legendary Starfighter”, art credit printed above the bottom margin (“Image courtesy of Paul Wiz Johnson@Artstation”); combat vehicle (back) side: errata mark “E”, label “(AI)”, bottom margin “Special Modifications”, lore “Han's “special modifications” for Millennium Falcon included security mechanisms, deflector shields, hull plating, faster hyperdrive and enhanced weapons. Enclosed.”.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (ALT) (Errata)]]): PC card image of the combat vehicle (back) side uploaded 12 December 2022<ref name="img-204_35a-1" />; the front image was unchanged. '''What changed:''' the back side was re-made: its lore “Han's “special modifications” …” → the front side's lore (“The Millennium Falcon's well-known reputation …”) followed by “Enclosed.”; bottom margin “Special Modifications” → “Legendary Starfighter”; errata mark “E” → “E2”; the Players Committee logo now prints left of “(AI)”; the art credit moved to the right edge (“Image courtesy of Paul “Wiz” Johnson @ ArtStation”) and the line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” was added; the game text is the same. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: starship (front) side: as in the original; combat vehicle (back) side: errata mark “E2”, label “(AI)”, Players Committee logo, bottom margin “Legendary Starfighter”, lore “The Millennium Falcon's well-known reputation is favorable not only for its captain and first mate, but for the Alliance as well. Enclosed.”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image of the starship (front) side uploaded 19 February 2023<ref name="img-204_35a-2" />. '''What changed:''' the front side was re-made like the back: the art credit moved from above the bottom margin to the right edge (“Image courtesy of Paul “Wiz” Johnson @ ArtStation”), the line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” was added, the Players Committee logo now prints left of “(AI)”, the two icons beside the game text swapped places and the game text is wrapped differently; the words are the same. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: starship (front) side: no errata mark, label “(AI)”, Players Committee logo, bottom margin “Legendary Starfighter”; combat vehicle (back) side: as in PC-E1 (errata mark “E2”). It is the current printing of the ALT card.
